## Context / Problem
Each review pass embeds its own full copy of the plan with no cross-pass cache reuse; the only shared bytes (~130-token preamble) sit below Anthropic's 1024-token cacheable minimum. Timing data shows inter-pass gaps of 50-100ms, so a prefix written in Pass-1 stays warm through Pass-2 under the default TTL. Incremental-depth BLOCK loops also need an exhaustiveness instruction in the shared finder stance. The passes render through different paths today: Pass-1 finder via passes._resolve_system (prepends passes._SHARED_PREAMBLE, then strip_volatile_marker keeps the whole body as system prompt; src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_finder.md has no volatile marker), while Pass-2 verify renders via the workflow RunnerAgentStep (src/rebar/llm/workflow/runs.py) -> prompts.resolve_prompt_cached -> split_volatile, with {{plan}} currently on the volatile side of src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_verifier.md and src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_verifier_agentic.md (the agentic arm is the primary production path), and the verifier's per-run finding listing injected separately via base_instructions (the user turn), not the template.

## Approach
Byte identity by construction, single-sourced: (1) prompts.py gains shared_plan_prefix(plan) -> str = [the shared stance preamble text + the exhaustiveness directive + the plan material block]. passes._SHARED_PREAMBLE is DELETED; its text moves into shared_plan_prefix (prompts.py is the single source; passes.py imports the helper and stops prepending its own preamble). The exhaustiveness directive is one sentence: enumerate every independent defect found in this run; do not defer deeper findings to a later round. (2) Pass-1 processing rule, stated exactly: _resolve_system returns shared_plan_prefix(plan) + the rendered finder template, where plan_review_finder.md is reduced to the finder-stance/instructions segment only ({{plan}} and the preamble are REMOVED from the template; no volatile marker is added — the prefix boundary is explicit in code). The whole concatenation remains the system prompt (no split on the Pass-1 path); per-chunk rubrics stay in instructions as today. (3) Verifier templates: both plan_review_verifier.md and plan_review_verifier_agentic.md are restructured so the STABLE segment (before their volatile marker) begins with a {{shared_prefix}} placeholder followed by the verifier stance; the render call supplies shared_prefix=shared_plan_prefix(plan) as a template variable, so the rendered stable segment's leading bytes equal Pass-1's leading bytes by construction, from one code source — no duplicated preamble text in any template. {{plan}} is removed from the volatile side. (4) The per-run finding listing continues to arrive via base_instructions (user turn) — unchanged mechanism; the byte-identity tests assert the listing text never appears in the rendered system stable segment. (5) src/rebar/llm/plan_review/fidelity_spot_eval.py: plan-review-verifier is already in RELOCATED_PROMPTS and plan-review-verifier-agentic is currently ABSENT — both entries are updated/added so its resolve_prompt_cached relocation requests match the restructured templates. (6) src/rebar/llm/workflow/runs.py is a consumer, audited, no mechanism change: it already renders via resolve_prompt_cached with variables; it now passes shared_prefix in the variable map at its verifier call sites. Container/ISF/coach prompts are NOT restructured in this change (separate prompt_ids and cache entries; unchanged behavior). Alternative rejected: raising the cache TTL to 1 hour — measured pass gaps never approach the 5-minute refresh-on-hit window and revise loops change the prefix bytes, so the 2x write premium buys nothing.

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompts.py (shared_plan_prefix; single-sourced preamble), src/rebar/llm/plan_review/passes.py (delete _SHARED_PREAMBLE; _resolve_system concatenation), src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_finder.md (reduce to stance segment), src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_verifier.md ({{shared_prefix}} stable segment), src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_verifier_agentic.md (same; primary path), src/rebar/llm/workflow/runs.py (pass shared_prefix variable at verifier call sites), src/rebar/llm/plan_review/fidelity_spot_eval.py (RELOCATED_PROMPTS entries incl. adding plan-review-verifier-agentic), tests/unit/workflow/test_shared_prefix.py (new).

## Testing
Unit (relative imports): for one fixture ticket, the Pass-1 system prompt's leading bytes and the rendered stable segments of BOTH verifier prompts each begin with shared_plan_prefix(plan) byte-for-byte; the prefix exceeds 1024 estimated tokens for a typical plan fixture; the exhaustiveness directive reaches every Pass-1 request (present in shared_plan_prefix); the finding listing (from base_instructions) never appears in any rendered system stable segment; _SHARED_PREAMBLE no longer exists in passes.py; existing plan-review workflow fixture tests pass with unchanged verdict behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Pass-1 system prompts and both verifier stable segments begin with byte-identical shared_plan_prefix(plan) containing the full plan material (checked: `pytest tests/unit/workflow/test_shared_prefix.py`).
- [ ] The preamble text is single-sourced in prompts.py and passes._SHARED_PREAMBLE is removed (checked: unit test asserting the symbol is gone and Pass-1 output starts with shared_plan_prefix).
- [ ] The exhaustiveness directive is in shared_plan_prefix and reaches every Pass-1 request (checked: unit test over recorded requests).
- [ ] The per-run finding listing remains user-turn-injected and absent from all rendered system stable segments (checked: unit test).
- [ ] Review verdict behavior on existing workflow fixtures is unchanged (checked: existing plan-review workflow tests pass unmodified).
